players.description: How many players the game is for: one count, or a [min, max] range the host picks inside. Leave it out to let the tags decide.

teams.description: 0 for no teams, or 2–16 teams dealt by seat under the team tag; one team is not allowed.

teamSize.description: Players per team. teams × teamSize must fit the declared players, and fixes the count when players is left out.
